in-basket: a wood or metal receptacle placed on your desk to hold your incoming material
in-fighting: conflict between members of the same organization (usually concealed from outsiders)
in-joke: a joke that is appreciated only by members of some particular group of people
in-migration: migration into a place (especially migration to a country of which you are not a native in order to settle there)
in-tray: a wood or metal receptacle placed on your desk to hold your incoming material
in-between: being neither at the beginning nor at the end in a series
in-bounds: between the first and third base lines
in-chief: indicating the head of a staff
in-person: an appearance carried out personally in someone else's physical presence
in-situ: being in the original position; not having been moved
